name: Ananya Krishnan
message: We booked IXORA for a quiet weekend and it felt like our own home. The courtyard at dusk and the campfire made the stay unforgettable.

name: Rahul & Meera
message: Perfect venue for our family gathering. Spacious 2 BHK, lovely dining space, and the photo point was a hit with everyone.

name: Fathima Naseer
message: Celebrated my sister’s birthday here. Stage, grill and games — everything was easy. Hosts were warm and helpful throughout.
